say:1:1130968001:1.text: Listen to yourself! How can you not appreciate such beautiful and agile creatures?
say:1:1130968001:1.source_cn: 听你这话说的！这么美丽又灵敏的动物，难道你就不喜欢吗？

say:2:1130968002:1.text: Truth be told, I've always felt it's the animal that best represents the Crimson Highlands. They should be cherished by all!
say:2:1130968002:1.source_cn: 实话实说，我一直觉得它是最能代表深红高原的动物，每个人...

say:3:1130968003:1.text: If I didn't live in Alkali with nowhere to properly keep one, I would've bought one from the Maulers long ago.
say:3:1130968003:1.source_cn: 要不是我住在咸水镇，没地养，我早就从蛮血手里买一只回去了。

say:4:1130968004:1.text: Look at the little one over there! It's so cute when it trips on its own feet.
say:4:1130968004:1.source_cn: ——你看对面那只小陆行鸟！跑着跑着就摔倒了，真可爱。
